data.name: Dybbuk
data.detailed_description:
Dybbuk is a Single player / Hybrid PvP & Co-op horror game.

Teamwork Is Your Lifeline. Players must coordinate, communicate, and make difficult choices:

Should you split up to find statues faster?

Maybe it's better to stay together and fend off summoned creatures?

Do you risk carrying a statue alone?

Can you trust the player helping you, or is he already possessed?

Your decisions shape the flow of every match.

Face an ancient evil in this action multiplayer horror PvP/Co-op game.

A malevolent Dybbuk stalks your team. It is capable of summoning monsters, manipulating the environment utilizing supernatural abilities.

But the greatest threat is its hunger for a host.

When a player is caught by the Dybbuk, it becomes possessed and turns into the new demon with full control of its arsenal.

Gather your team, hunt the Dybbuk, and try to survive a shifting nightmare -

The monster can be any one of you!

Seal the Demon in the dybbuk box.

Your only hope is to locate and retrieve statues of Mesopotamian deities hidden throughout the environment. These sacred artifacts are the Dybbuk’s weakness. Return them to the Dybbuk Box, a vessel of containment and exorcism, to strip the demon of its powers.

  • Each statue removes one demonic ability

  • Every ability removed shifts the balance of power

  • The final statue will seal the Dybbuk in the box.

  • Carrying a statue makes you vulnerable.

The Dybbuk senses your intent and it will come for you.

A Win Condition Built on Urgency and Betrayal

Only non-possessed players can win. Once possessed, players must quickly pass the Dybbuk to another host before its abilities are stripped away! creating constant pressure and shifting power dynamics.

Key Features.

  • Levels are procedurally generated each match, delivering fresh layouts and unpredictable encounters for high replayability.

  • Face a highly adaptive and intelligent enemy AI that reacts to player behavior, tracks movement and sound, and dynamically adjusts its tactics. Enemies coordinate, ambush, and exploit mistakes creating tense, unscripted horror encounters.

  • PvP & Co-op Hybrid Gameplay Work together to survive, but prepare to face former teammates once they become possessed.

  • Dynamic Demon Abilities: The Dybbuk can summon creatures, set traps, deceive players, and more. Each deity statue removed strips the demon of one ability, creating shifting power waves throughout the match.

data.short_description: Cooperate to survive, or become the monster. You must hunt the demon as it strives to possess players and turn them against each other. To weaken the Dybbuk you have to collect ancient Mesopotamian statues and seal it away before it’s too late.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 390
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10600 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 3070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
